title: Quran, Sura 15 (al-ḥiǧr) (Codex Parisino-petropolitanus)
source: Codex Parisino-petropolitanus (BnF Arabe 328) via Gallica IIIF + Corpus Coranicum folio mapping + Tanzil + Pickthall
description: Sura 15 (al-ḥiǧr) from the Codex Parisino-petropolitanus (c. 650-750 AD), one section per folio side, each linked to the exact Gallica image of that page (3 pages).
introduction:
Sura 15 (al-ḥiǧr) as preserved on 3 folio sides of the Codex Parisino-petropolitanus (Paris, BnF Arabe 328 (a) and (b)), one of the oldest surviving Quran manuscripts, written in hijazi script on parchment, c. 650-750 AD. Each section below is one folio side, and the image shown is that exact page.

  1. Manuscript scan: the specific folio side from Gallica (Bibliotheque nationale de France IIIF). The folio's sura:verse range was taken from the Corpus Coranicum "Manuscripta Coranica" record for that page, which states the first and last word on the page; the folio numbers of both services were cross-checked by comparing the two images pixel by pixel.
  2. Original text: the Arabic of the Tanzil Project Uthmani text (CC BY 3.0), reproduced unchanged, verse by verse.
  3. English: Marmaduke Pickthall, The Meaning of the Glorious Koran (1930), public domain, verse by verse.

Orthography: the codex is written in scriptio defectiva: no vowel signs, almost no consonantal dots, long vowels often unwritten, and letter shapes that differ from the printed Uthmani text. The modern text given here therefore differs orthographically from what is on the folio while conveying the same reading; readers should expect, for example, the basmala and words such as qala to be spelled with fewer letters on the page.

Numbering: verse numbers follow the standard Kufan (Cairo 1924) division used by Corpus Coranicum, Tanzil and Pickthall. Early codices mark verse ends with ink dots that in places divide the text differently, so a verse count made on the page may not match these numbers exactly. In Tanzil's text the basmala opening each sura (except sura 9) is printed as part of verse 1. Where a page begins or ends in the middle of a verse the whole verse is given and the word position is stated in the section heading.

Lacunae: the surviving Paris leaves do not carry every verse of this sura. Only the verses listed in the sections below are on the folios shown; the rest of the sura is lost or preserved in other fragments of the same codex (St Petersburg Marcel 18, Vatican Ar. 1605/1, London KFQ 60) that are not included here.
translator_notes: 87 of 99 verses of this sura survive on the Paris leaves of the codex (3 folio sides).
Corpus Coranicum records the first and last word of each page; a verse split across two pages is shown in full under both pages with the word position noted.

translation.original_ref: Quran 15:1-19, BnF Arabe 328 fol. 53v (page ends at word 1 of 15:19; page begins in sura 14 (14:44))
translation.original_text: <sup>1</sup>بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ الٓر تِلْكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَقُرْءَانٍ مُّبِينٍ <sup>2</sup>رُّبَمَا يَوَدُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ مُسْلِمِينَ <sup>3</sup>ذَرْهُمْ يَأْكُلُوا۟ وَيَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ وَيُلْهِهِمُ ٱلْأَمَلُ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ <sup>4</sup>وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا وَلَهَا كِتَابٌ مَّعْلُومٌ <sup>5</sup>مَّا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ <sup>6</sup>وَقَالُوا۟ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِى نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ إِنَّكَ لَمَجْنُونٌ <sup>7</sup>لَّوْ مَا تَأْتِينَا بِٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ <sup>8</sup>مَا نُنَزِّلُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَمَا كَانُوٓا۟ إِذًا مُّنظَرِينَ <sup>9</sup>إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا ٱلذِّكْرَ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ لَحَٰفِظُونَ <sup>10</sup>وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ فِى شِيَعِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ <sup>11</sup>وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ <sup>12</sup>كَذَٰلِكَ نَسْلُكُهُۥ فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ <sup>13</sup>لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ وَقَدْ خَلَتْ سُنَّةُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ <sup>14</sup>وَلَوْ فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِم بَابًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَظَلُّوا۟ فِيهِ يَعْرُجُونَ <sup>15</sup>لَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَا سُكِّرَتْ أَبْصَٰرُنَا بَلْ نَحْنُ قَوْمٌ مَّسْحُورُونَ <sup>16</sup>وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ بُرُوجًا وَزَيَّنَّٰهَا لِلنَّٰظِرِينَ <sup>17</sup>وَحَفِظْنَٰهَا مِن كُلِّ شَيْطَٰنٍ رَّجِيمٍ <sup>18</sup>إِلَّا مَنِ ٱسْتَرَقَ ٱلسَّمْعَ فَأَتْبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٌ مُّبِينٌ <sup>19</sup>وَٱلْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَٰهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ مَّوْزُونٍ
translation.text: <sup>1</sup>Alif. Lam. Ra. These are verses of the Scripture and a plain Reading. <sup>2</sup>It may be that those who disbelieve wish ardently that they were Muslims. <sup>3</sup>Let them eat and enjoy life, and let (false) hope beguile them. They will come to know! <sup>4</sup>And We destroyed no township but there was a known decree for it. <sup>5</sup>No nation can outstrip its term nor can they lag behind. <sup>6</sup>And they say: O thou unto whom the Reminder is revealed, lo! thou art indeed a madman! <sup>7</sup>Why bringest thou not angels unto us, if thou art of the truthful? <sup>8</sup>We send not down the angels save with the Fact, and in that case (the disbelievers) would not be tolerated. <sup>9</sup>Lo! We, even We, reveal the Reminder, and lo! We verily are its Guardian. <sup>10</sup>We verily sent (messengers) before thee among the factions of the men of old. <sup>11</sup>And never came there unto them a messenger but they did mock him. <sup>12</sup>Thus do We make it traverse the hearts of the guilty: <sup>13</sup>They believe not therein, though the example of the men of old hath gone before. <sup>14</sup>And even if We opened unto them a gate of heaven and they kept mounting through it, <sup>15</sup>They would say: Our sight is wrong - nay, but we are folk bewitched. <sup>16</sup>And verily in the heaven we have set mansions of the stars, and We have beautified it for beholders. <sup>17</sup>And We have guarded it from every outcast devil, <sup>18</sup>Save him who stealeth the hearing, and them doth a clear flame pursue. <sup>19</sup>And the earth have We spread out, and placed therein firm hills, and caused each seemly thing to grow therein.

translation.original_ref: Quran 15:19-52, BnF Arabe 328 fol. 54r (page begins at word 2 of 15:19; page ends at word 7 of 15:52)
translation.original_text: <sup>19</sup>وَٱلْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَٰهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ مَّوْزُونٍ <sup>20</sup>وَجَعَلْنَا لَكُمْ فِيهَا مَعَٰيِشَ وَمَن لَّسْتُمْ لَهُۥ بِرَٰزِقِينَ <sup>21</sup>وَإِن مِّن شَىْءٍ إِلَّا عِندَنَا خَزَآئِنُهُۥ وَمَا نُنَزِّلُهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِقَدَرٍ مَّعْلُومٍ <sup>22</sup>وَأَرْسَلْنَا ٱلرِّيَٰحَ لَوَٰقِحَ فَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَأَسْقَيْنَٰكُمُوهُ وَمَآ أَنتُمْ لَهُۥ بِخَٰزِنِينَ <sup>23</sup>وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَنَحْنُ ٱلْوَٰرِثُونَ <sup>24</sup>وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا ٱلْمُسْتَقْدِمِينَ مِنكُمْ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا ٱلْمُسْتَـْٔخِرِينَ <sup>25</sup>وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ إِنَّهُۥ حَكِيمٌ عَلِيمٌ <sup>26</sup>وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن صَلْصَٰلٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ <sup>27</sup>وَٱلْجَآنَّ خَلَقْنَٰهُ مِن قَبْلُ مِن نَّارِ ٱلسَّمُومِ <sup>28</sup>وَإِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّى خَٰلِقٌۢ بَشَرًا مِّن صَلْصَٰلٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ <sup>29</sup>فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُۥ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِى فَقَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ سَٰجِدِينَ <sup>30</sup>فَسَجَدَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ <sup>31</sup>إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ أَبَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ <sup>32</sup>قَالَ يَٰٓإِبْلِيسُ مَا لَكَ أَلَّا تَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ <sup>33</sup>قَالَ لَمْ أَكُن لِّأَسْجُدَ لِبَشَرٍ خَلَقْتَهُۥ مِن صَلْصَٰلٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ <sup>34</sup>قَالَ فَٱخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌ <sup>35</sup>وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ ٱللَّعْنَةَ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ <sup>36</sup>قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرْنِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ <sup>37</sup>قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنظَرِينَ <sup>38</sup>إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْوَقْتِ ٱلْمَعْلُومِ <sup>39</sup>قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَآ أَغْوَيْتَنِى لَأُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ <sup>40</sup>إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ <sup>41</sup>قَالَ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ عَلَىَّ مُسْتَقِيمٌ <sup>42</sup>إِنَّ عِبَادِى لَيْسَ لَكَ عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَٰنٌ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْغَاوِينَ <sup>43</sup>وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمَوْعِدُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ <sup>44</sup>لَهَا سَبْعَةُ أَبْوَٰبٍ لِّكُلِّ بَابٍ مِّنْهُمْ جُزْءٌ مَّقْسُومٌ <sup>45</sup>إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ <sup>46</sup>ٱدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَٰمٍ ءَامِنِينَ <sup>47</sup>وَنَزَعْنَا مَا فِى صُدُورِهِم مِّنْ غِلٍّ إِخْوَٰنًا عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مُّتَقَٰبِلِينَ <sup>48</sup>لَا يَمَسُّهُمْ فِيهَا نَصَبٌ وَمَا هُم مِّنْهَا بِمُخْرَجِينَ <sup>49</sup>نَبِّئْ عِبَادِىٓ أَنِّىٓ أَنَا ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ <sup>50</sup>وَأَنَّ عَذَابِى هُوَ ٱلْعَذَابُ ٱلْأَلِيمُ <sup>51</sup>وَنَبِّئْهُمْ عَن ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ <sup>52</sup>إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَٰمًا قَالَ إِنَّا مِنكُمْ وَجِلُونَ
translation.text: <sup>19</sup>And the earth have We spread out, and placed therein firm hills, and caused each seemly thing to grow therein. <sup>20</sup>And we have given unto you livelihoods therein, and unto those for whom ye provide not. <sup>21</sup>And there is not a thing but with Us are the stores thereof. And we send it not down save in appointed measure. <sup>22</sup>And We send the winds fertilising, and cause water to descend from the sky, and give it you to drink. It is not ye who are the holders of the store thereof. <sup>23</sup>Lo! and it is We, even We, Who quicken and give death, and We are the Inheritor. <sup>24</sup>And verily We know the eager among you and verily We know the laggards. <sup>25</sup>Lo! thy Lord will gather them together. Lo! He is Wise, Aware. <sup>26</sup>Verily We created man of potter's clay of black mud altered, <sup>27</sup>And the jinn did We create aforetime of essential fire. <sup>28</sup>And (remember) when thy Lord said unto the angels: Lo! I am creating a mortal out of potter's clay of black mud altered, <sup>29</sup>So, when I have made him and have breathed into him of My Spirit, do ye fall down, prostrating yourselves unto him. <sup>30</sup>So the angels fell prostrate, all of them together <sup>31</sup>Save Iblis. He refused to be among the prostrate. <sup>32</sup>He said: O Iblis! What aileth thee that thou art not among the prostrate? <sup>33</sup>He said: I am not one to prostrate myself unto a mortal whom Thou hast created out of potter's clay of black mud altered! <sup>34</sup>He said: Then go thou forth from hence, for lo! thou art outcast. <sup>35</sup>And lo! the curse shall be upon thee till the Day of Judgment. <sup>36</sup>He said: My Lord! Reprieve me till the day when they are raised. <sup>37</sup>He said: Then lo! thou art of those reprieved <sup>38</sup>Till the Day of appointed time. <sup>39</sup>He said: My Lord! Because Thou hast sent me astray, I verily shall adorn the path of error for them in the earth, and shall mislead them every one, <sup>40</sup>Save such of them as are Thy perfectly devoted slaves. <sup>41</sup>He said: This is a right course incumbent upon Me: <sup>42</sup>Lo! as for My slaves, thou hast no power over any of them save such of the froward as follow thee, <sup>43</sup>And lo! for all such, hell will be the promised place. <sup>44</sup>It hath seven gates, and each gate hath an appointed portion. <sup>45</sup>Lo! those who ward off (evil) are among gardens and watersprings. <sup>46</sup>(And it is said unto them): Enter them in peace, secure. <sup>47</sup>And We remove whatever rancour may be in their breasts. As brethren, face to face, (they rest) on couches raised. <sup>48</sup>Toil cometh not unto them there, nor will they be expelled from thence. <sup>49</sup>Announce, (O Muhammad) unto My slaves that verily I am the Forgiving, the Merciful, <sup>50</sup>And that My doom is the dolorous doom. <sup>51</sup>And tell them of Abraham's guests, <sup>52</sup>(How) when they came in unto him, and said: Peace. He said: Lo! we are afraid of you.

translation.original_ref: Quran 15:52-87, BnF Arabe 328 fol. 54v (page begins at word 8 of 15:52; page ends at word 4 of 15:87)
translation.original_text: <sup>52</sup>إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَٰمًا قَالَ إِنَّا مِنكُمْ وَجِلُونَ <sup>53</sup>قَالُوا۟ لَا تَوْجَلْ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَٰمٍ عَلِيمٍ <sup>54</sup>قَالَ أَبَشَّرْتُمُونِى عَلَىٰٓ أَن مَّسَّنِىَ ٱلْكِبَرُ فَبِمَ تُبَشِّرُونَ <sup>55</sup>قَالُوا۟ بَشَّرْنَٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَلَا تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْقَٰنِطِينَ <sup>56</sup>قَالَ وَمَن يَقْنَطُ مِن رَّحْمَةِ رَبِّهِۦٓ إِلَّا ٱلضَّآلُّونَ <sup>57</sup>قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ <sup>58</sup>قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ مُّجْرِمِينَ <sup>59</sup>إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍ إِنَّا لَمُنَجُّوهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ <sup>60</sup>إِلَّا ٱمْرَأَتَهُۥ قَدَّرْنَآ إِنَّهَا لَمِنَ ٱلْغَٰبِرِينَ <sup>61</sup>فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ءَالَ لُوطٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ <sup>62</sup>قَالَ إِنَّكُمْ قَوْمٌ مُّنكَرُونَ <sup>63</sup>قَالُوا۟ بَلْ جِئْنَٰكَ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَمْتَرُونَ <sup>64</sup>وَأَتَيْنَٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَإِنَّا لَصَٰدِقُونَ <sup>65</sup>فَأَسْرِ بِأَهْلِكَ بِقِطْعٍ مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱتَّبِعْ أَدْبَٰرَهُمْ وَلَا يَلْتَفِتْ مِنكُمْ أَحَدٌ وَٱمْضُوا۟ حَيْثُ تُؤْمَرُونَ <sup>66</sup>وَقَضَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْأَمْرَ أَنَّ دَابِرَ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ مَقْطُوعٌ مُّصْبِحِينَ <sup>67</sup>وَجَآءَ أَهْلُ ٱلْمَدِينَةِ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ <sup>68</sup>قَالَ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ ضَيْفِى فَلَا تَفْضَحُونِ <sup>69</sup>وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَلَا تُخْزُونِ <sup>70</sup>قَالُوٓا۟ أَوَلَمْ نَنْهَكَ عَنِ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ <sup>71</sup>قَالَ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ بَنَاتِىٓ إِن كُنتُمْ فَٰعِلِينَ <sup>72</sup>لَعَمْرُكَ إِنَّهُمْ لَفِى سَكْرَتِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ <sup>73</sup>فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ مُشْرِقِينَ <sup>74</sup>فَجَعَلْنَا عَٰلِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِّن سِجِّيلٍ <sup>75</sup>إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَٰتٍ لِّلْمُتَوَسِّمِينَ <sup>76</sup>وَإِنَّهَا لَبِسَبِيلٍ مُّقِيمٍ <sup>77</sup>إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ <sup>78</sup>وَإِن كَانَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ لَظَٰلِمِينَ <sup>79</sup>فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ وَإِنَّهُمَا لَبِإِمَامٍ مُّبِينٍ <sup>80</sup>وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْحِجْرِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ <sup>81</sup>وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُمْ ءَايَٰتِنَا فَكَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ <sup>82</sup>وَكَانُوا۟ يَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا ءَامِنِينَ <sup>83</sup>فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ مُصْبِحِينَ <sup>84</sup>فَمَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ <sup>85</sup>وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَإِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ لَـَٔاتِيَةٌ فَٱصْفَحِ ٱلصَّفْحَ ٱلْجَمِيلَ <sup>86</sup>إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ ٱلْخَلَّٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ <sup>87</sup>وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَٰكَ سَبْعًا مِّنَ ٱلْمَثَانِى وَٱلْقُرْءَانَ ٱلْعَظِيمَ
translation.text: <sup>52</sup>(How) when they came in unto him, and said: Peace. He said: Lo! we are afraid of you. <sup>53</sup>They said: Be not afraid! Lo! we bring thee good tidings of a boy possessing wisdom. <sup>54</sup>He said: Bring ye me good tidings (of a son) when old age hath overtaken me? Of what then can ye bring good tidings? <sup>55</sup>They said: We bring thee good tidings in truth. So be not thou of the despairing. <sup>56</sup>He said: And who despaireth of the mercy of his Lord save those who are astray? <sup>57</sup>He said: And afterward what is your business, O ye messengers (of Allah)? <sup>58</sup>They said: We have been sent unto a guilty folk, <sup>59</sup>(All) save the family of Lot. Them we shall deliver every one, <sup>60</sup>Except his wife, of whom We had decreed that she should be of those who stay behind. <sup>61</sup>And when the messengers came unto the family of Lot, <sup>62</sup>He said: Lo! ye are folk unknown (to me). <sup>63</sup>They said: Nay, but we bring thee that concerning which they keep disputing, <sup>64</sup>And bring thee the Truth, and lo! we are truth-tellers. <sup>65</sup>So travel with thy household in a portion of the night, and follow thou their backs. Let none of you turn round, but go whither ye are commanded. <sup>66</sup>And We made plain the case to him, that the root of them (who did wrong) was to be cut at early morn. <sup>67</sup>And the people of the city came, rejoicing at the news (of new arrivals). <sup>68</sup>He said: Lo! they are my guests. Affront me not! <sup>69</sup>And keep your duty to Allah, and shame me not! <sup>70</sup>They said; Have we not forbidden you from (entertaining) anyone? <sup>71</sup>He said: Here are my daughters, if ye must be doing (so). <sup>72</sup>By thy life (O Muhammad) they moved blindly in the frenzy of approaching death. <sup>73</sup>Then the (Awful) Cry overtook them at the sunrise. <sup>74</sup>And We utterly confounded them, and We rained upon them stones of heated clay. <sup>75</sup>Lo! therein verily are portents for those who read the signs. <sup>76</sup>And lo! it is upon a road still uneffaced. <sup>77</sup>Lo! therein is indeed a portent for believers. <sup>78</sup>And the dwellers in the wood indeed were evil-doers. <sup>79</sup>So we took vengeance on them; and lo! they both are on a high-road plain to see. <sup>80</sup>And the dwellers in Al-Hijr denied (Our) messengers. <sup>81</sup>And we gave them Our revelations, but they were averse to them. <sup>82</sup>And they used to hew out dwellings from the hills, (wherein they dwelt) secure. <sup>83</sup>But the (Awful) Cry overtook them at the morning hour, <sup>84</sup>And that which they were wont to count as gain availed them not. <sup>85</sup>We created not the heavens and the earth and all that is between them save with truth, and lo! the Hour is surely coming. So forgive, (O Muhammad), with a gracious forgiveness. <sup>86</sup>Lo! Thy Lord! He is the All-Wise Creator. <sup>87</sup>We have given thee seven of the oft-repeated (verses) and the great Qur'an.
